verdict.rationale: Railway documents user-specified conditions that automatically send Slack, Discord, or email alerts, which is a basic event-triggered rule. The only documented action is a notification, so this covers a thin slice of the story. Built-in automatic behaviours such as per-PR previews are not user-defined rules and earn no credit. Missing for 10: user-defined rules that trigger non-notification actions (e.g. redeploy, scale, rollback or agent tasks), documented rule syntax and event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Slack, Discord, or emails the moment conditions you specify are met.
